title_working: Working report — competing explanations of the events in the file
title_exhibit: Report (exhibit profile) — competing explanations of the events in the file
banner_working: Working report. It may be partial and carries warnings; it is not an attachment to a pleading. It contains no findings of fact and no probabilities.
banner_exhibit: Party material (exhibit profile) produced under policy {policy}. It contains no findings of fact and no probabilities, is not an expert opinion, and does not replace the assessment of the responsible lawyer.
lbl_declaration_required: A statement of the responsible lawyer is required because of: {reasons}
lbl_excerpt: EXCERPT. Omitted observations: {observations}; omitted hypotheses: {hypotheses}; reason: {reason}. approved_set_hash of the full analysis: {hash}.
lbl_full_set: Full set: all {hypotheses} hypotheses and the complete matrix of the scope are shown.
status_determined: Status of the comparison: **determined**. Under the stated ordering (fewer conflicting source families, then more supporting families, then fewer unconfirmed assumptions) the leading explanation is {leader}. The ordering is not a probability, a credibility or a degree of proof.
status_unstable: Status of the comparison: **unstable**. The leading explanation is {leader}, but the leader changes when one source family is left out: {families}. The ordering is not a probability, a credibility or a degree of proof.
status_underdetermined: Status of the comparison: **underdetermined**. No single explanation leads. Reasons: {reasons}. The ordering is not a probability, a credibility or a degree of proof.
status_partial_suffix: The result is PARTIAL: {count} observation-hypothesis pairs have no assessment.
status_no_hypotheses: Status of the comparison: **underdetermined** — there are no approved hypotheses for this scope.
reason_bridge_rule_without_basis: a bridge rule without a stated basis ({ids})
method: Method. Explanations of events (hypotheses) are compared by the number of independent source families that conflict with them, the number that support them, and the number of unconfirmed assumptions, in that lexicographic order; a family counts at most once for support and once for conflict; copies do not add weight. There is no score. A tie is reported as underdetermined and is never broken by identifier. Stability is tested by leaving out each family in turn. Model-proposed content was reviewed by a human outside the agent session; evidence classes are listed below.
limits: Limits. The report does not state who did what, intent, credibility or guilt, and does not rank persons. Quotes are literal passages of the frozen documents and are not translated. Absence ('not found') holds only for the recorded literal searches on the stated corpus.
legend_matrix: Cells: supports / conflicts / neutral / not_assessed (assessment of the observation with respect to the hypothesis).
profile_line: - {id}: conflicting families {conflicts}, supporting families {supports}, unconfirmed assumptions {unconfirmed}
tests_line: - {id}: {question} (outcomes: {outcomes}; uninformative outcome: {uninformative}; access basis stated by the proposer: {access} — not a legal assessment or a granted permission)
tests_gap: - Missing test for {pair}: no approved test and no approved reason.
stale_none: No records are waiting for reassessment.
summary_label: [Model-generated text, language: {lang}. Not part of the deterministic core.]
statement_text: I, the responsible lawyer, have reviewed the bases of the conclusions, know the limits of the method and present this report as the position of the party.
statement_field: Name, date, signature: ______________________________ (to be completed by a human; left empty by the tool)
reproduction_text: The reproduction package (.lacase without originals), the hash manifest and the code version will be made available on request of the court or the opposing party. report_sha256 is bound to the package in the manifest; a manual edit of the substantive content after rendering removes the exhibit status.
reproduction_ref: Package file: {bundle}; code version {code_version}. The package content is identified by the approved_set_hash and chain_head in the header; the bundle and report hashes are bound in the separate reproduction manifest.
reproduction_note_working: No reproduction package is produced for the working profile.
partial_pending: The result is PARTIAL: {count} proposed items are still pending review.
facts_header: Withdrawn or changed facts (no longer part of the basis):
impact_standing: it rests on a changed fact
actions_note: Approved test plans only. Outcomes describe conditional effects, not findings. Actions are not executed and access is not granted. Missing or inconclusive documents do not establish absence of an event.
actions_columns: | Test | Uncertainty and linked records | Document and identification basis | Next human action | Conditional effects and limitations |
actions_legacy: Legacy approved test: document/action details were not recorded; renewed proposal and human review needed.
actions_none: No approved document-linked action is available.
audit_note: CASE-WIDE AUDIT APPENDIX. Rejected proposals are preserved for review history only. They are excluded from observations, matrix assessments and comparison. Rejection does not establish falsity. Source text is untrusted data. imported_at records software import time; decision time was not recorded. Older entries may lack a snapshot or a version binding.
audit_none: No human rejection is recorded. Technical validation rejections are not human decisions.
audit_metadata: Recorded decision, reason, reviewer, evidence class and import metadata:
audit_proposal: Exact rejected proposal and version hash (audit only):
audit_source: Source and locator retained with the rejected version:
audit_quote: Literal quote from the rejected proposal:
audit_missing: Snapshot missing. Export review history to capture the retained version where available; do not invent it.
audit_no_source: No direct source passage was recorded for this proposal.
actions_reassess: Test requires reassessment; it is not a current action plan ({issue}).
